nodes.name: RA Completion Webhook
nodes.notes: EXTERNAL COMPLETION ENTRY - runner/webhook endpoint for completed RA reports. Accepts case_id, agent/ra_code, report_url/report_json, status.

nodes.name: RA Completion Trigger
nodes.notes: MCP/SUB-WORKFLOW ENTRY - structured completion receiver called by CAR Trigger MCP or internal tooling.

nodes.name: Code: Normalize RA Completion
nodes.notes: NORMALIZER - validates case_id and RA code, maps RA code to the correct WF-07 pre-DD signal, and normalizes report fields.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO car_case_ra (case_id, agent, status, report, report_json, completed_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, now())
ON CONFLICT (case_id, agent) DO UPDATE
SET status = EXCLUDED.status,
    report = EXCLUDED.report,
    report_json = COALESCE(car_case_ra.report_json, '{}'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.report_json || jsonb_build_object('report_url', $6::text, 'report_json_path', $7::text, 'completed_by', $8::text, 'completion_notes', $9::text, 'completed_at', now()),
    completed_at = now()
RETURNING id, case_id, agent, status, completed_at;

nodes.name: Postgres: Save RA Result
nodes.notes: RESULT PERSISTENCE - upserts the RA result into car_case_ra, which WF-07 reads when generating the DD report.

parameters.jsCode:
const payloads = $('Code: Normalize RA Completion').all();
return $input.all().map((item, index) => ({ json: { ...payloads[index].json, ra_record_id: item.json.id, completed_at: item.json.completed_at } }));

nodes.name: Code: Restore Completion Payload
nodes.notes: PAYLOAD RESTORE - re-attaches signal_type/report URL after the DB write.

nodes.name: Execute: signal_completion
nodes.notes: GATE SIGNAL - sends raXX_ready to WF-07-A after the RA result is saved.

parameters.message:
=RA completion recorded
Case: {{ $("Code: Restore Completion Payload").item.json.case_id }}
Agent: {{ $("Code: Restore Completion Payload").item.json.agent }}
Signal: {{ $("Code: Restore Completion Payload").item.json.signal_type }}
Report: {{ $("Code: Restore Completion Payload").item.json.report_url || "not supplied" }}

nodes.name: Teams: RA Completion Recorded
nodes.notes: TEAMS NOTICE - confirms the RA result was saved and the matching DD gate signal was emitted.
